archetypes.name: kv-forwarding
archetypes.rationale: New wrapper scripts must re-emit child stdout KV tokens unchanged; any wrapper that absorbs or reformats child output will silently break orchestrator state parsing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine every new wrapper script (step-0-bootstrap.sh, step-0-degraded-gate.sh, step-2-entry.sh, run-step-checks.sh, step-5-entry.sh, step-5-resume.sh, step-6-entry.sh, step-8-ship.sh, step-8-oos-checkpoint.sh, step-16.sh, step-17.sh, step-18a-gate.sh, step-18-finalize.sh) and verify that each one correctly re-emits every KV token produced by child scripts on its own stdout. Pay special attention to wrappers that capture child stdout into a variable before processing — check whether load-bearing keys such as OOS_CHECKPOINT_RC, EMIT_BODY, WFR_RC, STALL_TRACKING_*, STEP17_EMITTED_PRESENT, and routing-envelope keys (IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, STALL_TRACKING, coder, etc.) survive and are forwarded to the orchestrator unchanged. Also check that each wrapper uses set +e / set -e around child invocations and faithfully propagates the child exit code as its own exit code, not a wrapped or swallowed value. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: reference-completeness
archetypes.rationale: Prose extracted from SKILL.md into reference files must be complete and correctly linked; missing MANDATORY pointers or truncated reference bodies cause agents to silently miss routing decisions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the three new reference files (skills/implement/references/rebase-checkpoint-routing.md, skills/implement/references/phantom-probe.md, skills/implement/references/ship-pr-exit-matrix.md) and verify that each contains the complete routing/contract body described in the plan — exit/KV routing lists, call-site registry, phantom-probe entrypoints and parsing rules, bash exit matrix including the autonomous CI-fix sub-procedure. Cross-check against the corresponding SKILL.md sections that were removed to confirm nothing was dropped or truncated. Also verify that the MANDATORY — READ ENTIRE FILE pointers added to SKILL.md are placed close enough to the relevant fences that an agent reading the file sequentially would load the reference before executing the step that depends on it. Check that agent-lint S030/G004 reachability is preserved for scripts referenced only inside the moved prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: self-rehydration-correctness
archetypes.rationale: The new in-script LARCH_* self-rehydration fallback added to commit-review-fixes.sh and commit-implementation.sh is a new pattern; if the variable checks or python3 cli.py read-key calls are wrong, telemetry will silently be written to wrong/empty ledger paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the in-script self-rehydration fallback added to skills/implement/scripts/commit-review-fixes.sh and skills/implement/scripts/commit-implementation.sh — specifically the condition that decides when to run the fallback (when LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER, LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID, and LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE are absent), the python3 cli.py session read-key invocations, and how the results are exported. Verify that the condition correctly handles the case where IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR is also absent or points to a non-existent directory, and that a failure of the read-key invocation does not abort the script under set -euo pipefail. Also check that the deletion of the standalone LARCH_* triplet fences (Steps 4 and 7 in SKILL.md) leaves no orchestrator code path where these scripts are invoked before the self-rehydration has any source to read from. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
